text: Three report pages, each answering one group of requirements from Lesson 84 — not one page trying to do everything.
Page one covers territory sales versus target. Page two covers category and subcategory margin. Page three covers reseller fulfillment and year-over-year trend.
Every page follows the same rules: headline card top-left and largest, bars sorted by the metric itself rather than alphabetically, and identical color conventions across all three pages.
Three pages, each with a five-second headline number. Lesson 90 adds the interactivity that lets a viewer actually explore past that headline.
